football_evidence.question: Can Old Dominion contain Georgia Southern’s explosive runs?
football_evidence.assessment: Some measured evidence supports EdgeDesk’s lean toward Old Dominion, and its own breakdown accounts for about 1.0 of the 2.2 points, but not the full gap. It is a research question, not a bet.

EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Old Dominion’s defensive line No. 30 nationally and Georgia Southern’s No. 118.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Old Dominion’s secondary No. 10 nationally and Georgia Southern’s No. 80.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Old Dominion’s linebackers No. 31 nationally and Georgia Southern’s No. 122.
contradicting: When Old Dominion has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Old Dominion’s offense has allowed a sack on 16.6% of its dropbacks, and Georgia Southern’s defense sacks the quarterback on 6.5% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Old Dominion has the ball (early downs): Old Dominion’s offense succeeds on 30.9% of its first- and second-down plays, and Georgia Southern’s defense allows success on 41.3% of first- and second-down plays (FBS average 42.8%).

When Old Dominion has the ball (the red zone): Old Dominion’s offense succeeds on 29.2% of its red-zone plays, and Georgia Southern’s defense allows success on 41.5% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.8%).

When Old Dominion has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Old Dominion’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 25.4% of its runs, and Georgia Southern’s defense stops 17.0% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).
quarterbacks: Quinn Henicle has completed 47 of 87 passes (54.0%) for 528 yards, 6.1 yards per attempt, 3 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in five games for Old Dominion, and has been sacked on 16 of 103 dropbacks.
Ryan Huff has completed 23 of 49 passes (46.9%) for 279 yards, 5.7 yards per attempt, 1 touchdown and 1 interception in three games for Old Dominion, and has been sacked on 12 of 61 dropbacks.

Max Johnson has completed 147 of 224 passes (65.6%) for 1,566 yards, 7.0 yards per attempt, 11 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in six games for Georgia Southern, and has been sacked on 7 of 231 dropbacks.
